item.title: Sinecod syrup (butamirate) for dry cough, 200 ml
item.description: Sinecod syrup contains the active substance butamirate , a cough suppressant used to relieve dry and irritating cough of various origins in adults and children from 3 years. It has a pleasant vanilla flavour and comes with a dosing cup or pipette. Active substance: butamirate Form: syrup Pack size: 200 ml How to use: Children 3-6 years: 5 ml three times daily. Children 6-12 years: 10 ml three times daily. Adolescents over 12: 15 ml three times daily. Adults: 15 ml four times daily. Do not use for more than 1 week without medical advice. Warnings: Not for children under 3 years or in the first trimester of pregnancy. Use later in pregnancy or while breastfeeding only if clearly necessary and under medical advice. May cause drowsiness; take care when driving. Do not combine with alcohol. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Smecta 3 g diosmectite oral suspension powder, 10 sachets
item.description: Smecta contains diosmectite, a natural purified clay that coats the intestinal lining and binds bacteria, viruses and toxins, helping to treat and stop the symptoms of acute diarrhoea of any cause, without speeding up or slowing down normal digestion. It is suitable for adults and children from age 2. Active substance: diosmectite 3 g Form: oral powder sachet Pack size: 10 sachets How to use: Dissolve the contents of one sachet in half a glass of water just before drinking. Adults take 3 sachets daily; children from 2 years take 2 sachets daily, doubled at the start of treatment if needed. Use for up to 7 days in adults, 3 days in children; take alongside an oral rehydration solution. Warnings: May cause constipation. See a doctor if symptoms do not improve or worsen. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Ibuprofen 400 STADA 400 mg film-coated tablets, 20 tablets
item.description: Ibuprofen 400 STADA contains ibuprofen 400 mg , a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID). It relieves pain and inflammation, for example in acute and chronic arthritis, gout attacks, or painful swelling after injuries. Active substance: ibuprofen 400 mg Form: film-coated tablet Pack size: 20 tablets How to use: Adults and adolescents from 15 years: 1200–2400 mg (3–6 tablets) per day; a single dose must not exceed 800 mg (2 tablets). Keep at least 4–6 hours between doses. Swallow whole with plenty of water, not on an empty stomach. Warnings: Do not use in the third trimester of pregnancy or in children under 15. Do not drink alcohol. Do not use higher doses or long-term without consulting a doctor. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: ACC Long 600 mg effervescent tablets, 10 tablets
item.description: ACC Long effervescent tablets contain acetylcysteine 600 mg , a mucolytic that thins and loosens thick mucus in the airways, making it easier to cough up and breathe more freely. It helps with productive cough linked to colds, flu, bronchitis, sinusitis and other airway infections, for adults and adolescents from 14 years. Active substance: acetylcysteine 600 mg Form: effervescent tablet Pack size: 10 tablets How to use: Adults and adolescents from 14 years: dissolve 1 tablet once daily, or split the tablet for two smaller doses, in a glass of water; drink after a meal. Drink plenty of fluids during treatment. Warnings: Not for children under 14. Not recommended with an active peptic ulcer or severe liver or kidney impairment. Space doses at least 2 hours apart from antibiotics. Ask your doctor before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Stoptussin syrup (butamirate + guaifenesin), 100 ml
item.description: Stoptussin syrup combines butamirate , which calms the cough reflex and relaxes airway spasms, with guaifenesin , an expectorant that thins mucus so a dry, irritating cough becomes easier to clear. It is suitable for children from 6 months, adolescents and adults. Active substance: butamirate + guaifenesin Form: syrup Pack size: 100 ml How to use: Dosed by body weight with the supplied measuring pipette or cup, taken after meals with a 4-6 hour gap between doses; adults 40-70 kg take 5 ml three times a day (see the leaflet for other weights). Do not use for more than 7 days without medical advice. Warnings: Not for children under 6 months or in the first trimester of pregnancy. Use in later pregnancy or breastfeeding only with a doctor's approval. Do not combine with alcohol. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Nolpaza 20 mg gastro-resistant tablets, 14 tablets
item.description: Nolpaza 20 mg contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that blocks the stomach's acid-producing pump to relieve heartburn and acid regurgitation. It provides relief for up to 24 hours and is intended for short-term, self-directed treatment of reflux symptoms in adults. Active substance: pantoprazole 20 mg Form: gastro-resistant tablet Pack size: 14 tablets How to use: Take one tablet once daily, swallowed whole without chewing, crushing or splitting. Continue for at least 2 to 3 days even if symptoms improve quickly, then stop once symptoms have fully resolved; do not self-treat for longer than 4 weeks without medical advice. Warnings: Not for use in children and adolescents under 18, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. See a doctor if symptoms do not improve after 2 weeks or if you have liver disease. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Zyrtec 10 mg tablets, 7 tablets
item.description: Zyrtec 10 mg tablets relieve the symptoms of seasonal and year-round allergic rhinitis, including a runny or blocked nose, sneezing, and itchy, watery eyes. The film-coated tablets contain cetirizine, a second-generation antihistamine that also helps with uncomplicated skin symptoms of hives such as itching and redness. Active substance: cetirizine 10 mg Form: film-coated tablet Pack size: 7 tablets How to use: Adults and children from 12 years take one tablet once daily. Children aged 6 to 12 years are usually given half a tablet twice daily. The tablet can be taken with or without food and swallowed with a little liquid. Warnings: Not for children under 6 years. Contains lactose and should not be combined with alcohol. Use with caution during pregnancy, breastfeeding or in patients with epilepsy, and take care when driving if drowsiness occurs. Cetirizine does not prevent severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis). Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Strepsils Plus throat spray, 20 ml
item.description: Strepsils Plus Spray combines the antiseptics dichlorobenzyl alcohol and amylmetacresol , which kill bacteria and viruses causing a sore throat and mouth infections, with lidocaine , a local anaesthetic that numbs the pain. It treats inflammatory and infectious conditions of the mouth and throat, including severe sore throat, gum inflammation and after tonsil surgery, and supports tonsillitis treatment. Active substance: dichlorobenzyl alcohol + amylmetacresol + lidocaine Form: oromucosal spray Pack size: 20 ml How to use: Adults and children from 12 years: 2 sprays onto the affected area of the mouth or throat, up to 6 times a day. Hold your breath while spraying. Do not eat or drink afterwards. Do not use for more than 3 days. Warnings: Not for children under 12. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Contains ethanol. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Hylo-Comod moisturizing eye drops, 10 ml
item.description: Hylo-Comod eye drops intensively moisturize the surface of the eye, support the natural stability of the tear film and bring relief from symptoms of dry eye syndrome, a foreign-body sensation or burning eyes, including after eye surgery. The active ingredient, sodium hyaluronate, occurs naturally in the eye and forms an even, stable, long-lasting protective film that resists being washed away without causing blurred vision. Active substance: sodium hyaluronate 0.1% Form: preservative-free and phosphate-free eye drops Pack size: 10 ml (about 300 drops) How to use: apply 1 drop to each eye 3 times daily; if used more often or symptoms last over a week, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Suitable for contact lens wearers, children, and pregnant or breastfeeding women. Usable for 6 months after opening. Read the instructions for use before use.
item.epace:tags: Artificial Tears, category:eye-care, Contact Lens Safe, Dry Eyes, pharmacy

item.title: Coldrex tablets (paracetamol + phenylephrine + vitamin C), 24 tablets
item.description: Coldrex tablets relieve the symptoms of flu and severe colds. They contain paracetamol , which reduces fever and eases sore throat, headache, muscle and joint pain; phenylephrine , which clears a blocked nose and sinuses to make breathing easier; and vitamin C , which helps replace levels that can run low during a cold or flu. Active substance: paracetamol + phenylephrine + vitamin C Form: tablet Pack size: 24 tablets How to use: Adolescents 12-15 years: 1 tablet every 4-6 hours. Adults and adolescents from 15 years, 34-60 kg: 1 tablet as needed; over 60 kg: 2 tablets. Maximum 8 tablets (4 g paracetamol) a day, with at least 4 hours between doses. Do not use for more than 7 days without medical advice. Warnings: Do not combine with other cold and flu remedies or other medicines containing paracetamol. Not for children under 12, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not drink alcohol. Read the patient information leaflet before use.
